notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (field ops orchestration) evaluating Redwood for agentic chat assistants that perform multi-step workflows (search -> plan -> act). Primary focus = streaming latency and deterministic tool-call behavior. POC plan: initial 2-week test on Hosted API to validate 1st-token streaming SLO and measure tool call reliability for chained actions. If latencies and failure rates acceptable, move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

Key requirements / quotes: 
- "\"Need sub-200ms first-token for UI streaming on standard queries; p99 under 350ms for multi-turn agent paths.\"" (CTO)
- tool orchestration: sequence of search + calendar API + CRM write; must handle tool timeouts and retries gracefully.
- audit + KMS + SSO are must-haves for procurement. Residency preference: US only for now.

Pricing / economics: tight on unit cost — aggressive per-token budget. Evaluating Hosted to prove latency, then request Dedicated pricing (guaranteed throughput + burst) if ROI positive.

Conversation history: short inbound demo (2026-02-10), follow-up pricing call (2026-02-24), security questionnaire submitted (2026-02-28). AE notes: team is pragmatic, will pilot quickly but needs concrete metrics (failure rate, retry overhead, bytes per call).

POC success criteria (client-side):
- streaming start latency median < 160ms, p99 < 350ms for US region;
- tool-call success rate > 99% for chained flows (retries allowed up to 2);
- end-to-end agent completion time within SLA (90% within 4s for simple flows, 95% within 12s for 3-step workflows).

Risks flagged: flaky third-party tool we call may dominate failures; need telemetry hooks and distributed tracing to attribute. Client asked for example tracing payloads and a recommended retry/backoff pattern.

AE next actions: provide sample streaming trace, template for tool-call telemetry, Dedicated pilot pricing options.
